title: Eisenkot invites Netanyahu’s party for ‘marathon’ Israeli coalition talks
summary: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has invited caretaker prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing Likud party for coalition talks, his centrist Yashar party said Saturday. The "marathon series of talks" starts Sunday, the party said, adding that the move reflected a commitment to form "the broadest possible government" after the October election…
